title: Is there any way to add user specific info to result of algolia?

comments.body: Hi, did you figure out how to do it @fab10m?

Hi Vincent, I closed the issue because I realized that the error was caused by my trivial mistake :-)
I did big steps forward, but I still have some doubts about which is the best approach:
1. append to the objects contained in data variable, the extra attribute retrieved throgh tha ajax request; then execute the function renderHits that compile the template with hogan.js.
2. render the page executing the function renderHits and then execute my function to modify the html

Do you have any kind of suggestion?

Regards
Is the data you want to add to hits related to the results you got from Algolia? Or can you get this data independently?
The data is only related to the objectID. Pratically, I need to add the info that tells whether a user is following or not an object.
Can you open another issue with a more descriptive content? It's a lot easier to deal with and for people to refer to in the future, thanks!
